title: M3COTBENCH: BENCHMARK CHAIN-OF-THOUGHT OF MLLMS IN MEDICAL IMAGE UNDERSTANDING
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models for medical diagnostics. While it includes sections on 'Social Impact' and mentions 'trustworthiness' and 'ethical standards' in the conclusion, these are standard research discussions and not part of the benchmarking or evaluation of religion, morals, or ethics.
